description: Erection of an additional storey to the roof to provide three x 2 bedroom flats to central accommodation block and with improved landscaping throughout the Kew Bridge Court estate
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (576_EX0001, 576_GA0001, 576_GA0101, 576_S01, 576.GE.01P1, 576.GE.02P1, 576.GE.03P1, 576.GE.04P1, 576.GS.01P1, 576.GS.02P1, 1055_PL_002 and Design and Access Statement, Energy Statement, Sustainable Design and Construction Statement received 06/12/2011, Flood Risk Assessment received 03/02/2012, 1055_PL_004, 549_S02 and 576_GA0001 received 06/02/2012 and 549_S03P1, 549_S04P1 received 09/02/2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority

Condition : 7 - A landscape management plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all hard and soft landscape areas, [other than small, privately owned, domestic gardens] shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority prior to the occupation of the development or any phase of the development, whichever is the sooner, for its permitted use.  The landscape management plan shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out in full compliance with the terms as set out in the submitted and approved Flood Risk Assessment unless otherwise agreed beforehand in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 9 - The development shall be carried out in full compliance with the terms as set out in the  submitted and approved unless otherwise agreed beforehand by the Local Planing Authority.

Condition : 10 - No development shall commence until details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show the proposed 'saw-tooth' window. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 11 - No development shall commence until details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show the proposed railings/balustrades. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
